name: yashmasalge/Air_traffic_Passenger_Statistics
what_it_holds: Committed CSV (Air_Traffic_Passenger_Statistics.csv) of San Francisco International Airport's official open-data release: monthly passenger counts by airline, terminal, and geographic region (domestic/international), used here for a K-means clustering exercise. Small, single-airport, unclear date range (SFO's public portal version runs ~2005-present).
why_useful: SFO is a decent West-Coast leisure/business proxy and the source (SFO open data portal) also publishes similar CSVs for enplanements by region — a template for pulling comparable structured monthly airport traffic that could stand in for regional US travel demand feeding Airbnb NA nights.
time_coverage: Monthly, range unclear from repo (likely subset of SFO's 2005-present portal history)
themes: wildcard: an airline network planner who knows capacity, schedule, far
why_all: SFO is a decent West-Coast leisure/business proxy and the source (SFO open data portal) also publishes similar CSVs for enplanements by region — a template for pulling comparable structured monthly airport traffic that could stand in for regional US travel demand feeding Airbnb NA nights.

name: zsszabo86/SatRday-Challenge
what_it_holds: Hungarian Central Statistical Office data on monthly passengers and available seats to/from Budapest Ferenc Liszt International Airport by origin country, 2007-2012, used for a ticket-sales-efficiency analysis.
why_useful: Old and narrow (pre-2013, one airport) but demonstrates a national-stats-office source (KSH) for scheduled seat capacity by origin country — a template for CEE regional air-capacity data that could flesh out EMEA regional mix; low direct value given the date range predates ABNB's operating history.
